definitions.name: W3D.BRED
definitions.note: bracket String -> same with every adjacent '()' and '[]' pair deleted once

definitions.name: W3D.BRED6
definitions.body: W3D.BRED W3D.BRED W3D.BRED W3D.BRED W3D.BRED W3D.BRED
definitions.note: bracket String (<=12 chars) -> fully reduced: all nested matched pairs deleted

definitions.name: W3D.BDELTA
definitions.note: one bracket character -> 1 for an opener ( [ and -1 for a closer ) ]

definitions.name: W3D.BPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS 'CS' BIND 0 CS LENGTH RANGE 'KS' BIND KS KS 0 MUL KS [ 'K' BIND CS K TAKE JOIN W3D.BRED6 '' EQ ] MAP SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty one)

definitions.name: W3D.UNWORDS
definitions.note: Vector of words -> one String joined by single spaces ('' for an empty Vector)

definitions.name: W3D.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: word -> first letter upper case, the rest lower case

definitions.name: W3D.ARGMAX
definitions.note: numeric Vector -> index of its largest value, the first one on ties

definitions.name: W3D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: TALLY 'TK' BIND TK KEYS TK VALUES W3D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Vector -> most frequent element, the one appearing first on ties

definitions.name: W3D.LSUMS
definitions.body: ZIP 'LZ' BIND LZ 0 GET LZ 1 GET GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ W2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs -> Record key -> sum of its amounts, keys in first-appearance order

definitions.name: W3D.RLESTEP
definitions.body: 'RE' BIND 'RA' BIND RA -1 GET 'RL' BIND RA -1 DROP RL 0 GET RL 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT RA RE 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RL 0 GET RE EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: FOLD step for run-length encoding: acc of [ value count ] pairs (non-empty) and next value -> new acc

definitions.name: W3D.RLE
definitions.note: Vector -> run-length encoding as Vector of [ value count ] pairs

definitions.name: W3D.LONGRUN
definitions.body: 0 [ 'LB' BIND 'LC' BIND LC 1 ADD 0 LB SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of truths -> length of the longest run of adjacent TRUE (0 when none)

definitions.name: W3D.NTRUE
definitions.note: Vector of truths -> how many are TRUE

definitions.name: W3D.GAPSTARTS
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP 'GM' BIND GM FALSE 1 COLLECT GM -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> truth per position: TRUE where a run of NILs begins

definitions.name: W3D.FILL
definitions.body: 'FV' BIND FV FV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'FE' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FE FE NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> forward-filled; leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: W3D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'SS' BIND SS LENGTH 'SN' BIND SS SN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SS SN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> median (mean of the two middle values when even)

definitions.name: W3D.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV TALLY 'MT' BIND MT VALUES W3D.ARGMAX 'MI' BIND MT KEYS MI GET NIL MT VALUES MI GET 2 MUL MV LENGTH GT SELECT
definitions.note: Vector -> the value in more than half the positions, or NIL

solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ W3D.BDELTA ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.top_name: W3D.LSUMS 'LR' BIND LR KEYS LR VALUES W3D.ARGMAX GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: W3D.LSUMS 'LR' BIND LR KEYS LR VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LE' BIND LE LE [ 1 GET ] MAP W3D.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ W3D.CAP ] MAP W3D.UNWORDS
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'PW' BIND PW PW [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP W3D.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.upruns: 'UV' BIND UV 1 DROP UV -1 DROP GT W3D.LONGRUN 1 ADD
solutions.runs.second_largest: UNIQUE SORT -2 GET 'S2' BIND NIL S2 S2 NIL? SELECT
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'RV' BIND RV 1 DROP RV -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'SV' BIND SV SV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER SORT -1 GET DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'MX' BIND MX MX W3D.MEDIAN SUB W3D.ABS W3D.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'TV' BIND TV -2 DROP TV 1 DROP -1 DROP TV 2 DROP ADD ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'RM' BIND RM RM 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
